answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. What survives to the velvet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, burned when the recruit misbehaves. A ferrous of per-task receipts records who did what, and the tide of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
